name: Exp_CMO
summary: This EA trades based on the CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) indicator, opening buy positions when the CMO crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative. It uses configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels, and only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant trading.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CMO（钱德动量摆动指标）进行交易，当CMO从负值区域上穿至正值区域时开多仓，从正值区域下穿至负值区域时开空仓。它使用可配置的手数、止损和止盈水平，并仅在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于CMO指标的零轴穿越进行动量交易。入场条件为：当CMO的前一根K线值大于0且当前K线值小于0时，产生买入信号；当CMO的前一根K线值小于0且当前K线值大于0时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发平仓（买入信号时平空仓，卖出信号时平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，具体逻辑未在本文件中展示。策略默认使用H4周期和14周期SMA平滑的CMO，信号取自第1根K线索引，属于延迟确认的趋势动量跟踪方法。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on CMO indicator zero-line crossovers. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the previous CMO bar value is above zero and the current bar value drops below zero (crossing downward), while a sell signal is generated when the previous value is below zero and the current value rises above zero (crossing upward). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, plus reverse signal exits where a buy signal closes short positions and a sell signal closes long positions. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on external functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, whose internal logic is not visible in this file. The default configuration uses H4 timeframe with a 14-period SMA-smoothed CMO, reading signals from bar index 1, making it a lagging-confirmation trend momentum approach.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，基于经典动量指标CMO零轴穿越，易于理解和验证
具有完整的买卖方向开关控制，可灵活关闭单方向交易
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数可配置，默认2:1的盈亏比设计合理
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on the classic CMO zero-line crossover, easy to understand and verify
Full directional control with separate buy/sell open and close permission switches for flexible configuration
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Configurable stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio
cons: 核心交易逻辑依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，无法直接审查仓位管理和订单执行的完整细节
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在流动性差的市场中可能遭受额外损失
CMO零轴穿越在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
没有追踪止损或动态止损机制，固定止损可能不适合所有市场波动环境
cons_en: Core trading logic depends on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making it impossible to fully audit position management and order execution details
Lacks spread filter and adequate slippage protection, potentially suffering extra losses in low-liquidity markets
CMO zero-line crossovers generate frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses
No trailing stop or dynamic stop loss mechanism; fixed stops may not suit all market volatility conditions
improvements: 增加CMO阈值过滤或超买超卖区间判断，避免在零轴附近震荡时频繁开平仓
增加点差过滤和多时间周期确认机制，提高信号质量和降低虚假信号比例
improvements_en: Add CMO threshold filtering or overbought/oversold zones to avoid frequent open/close cycles when oscillating near the zero line
Add spread filtering and multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal quality and reduce false signal ratio

risk_points: CMO零轴穿越在震荡市中频繁虚假信号可能导致连续止损
外部库函数的具体风控逻辑不可见，仓位管理安全性无法确认
risk_points_en: Frequent false signals from CMO zero-line crossovers in ranging markets can lead to consecutive stop losses
External library's risk control logic is not visible, so position management safety cannot be confirmed
